# Radoslav Radev Says Three Planche Workouts Per Week Are Enough If You Follow A Strategy Consistently

Radoslav Radev says it is really important to have a strategy and to follow it, because it makes you consistent, and that you can train three times per week. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 06:40]

## Details

- He says it is really important to have a strategy and to follow it, because it makes you consistent. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 06:35]
- He says you can train three times per week, but consistently, and track your results. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 06:45]
